name: produce-product-assets
job: Produce product assets to brief and brand constraints: one reproducible Product Asset Production Pack with provenance and exact-file QA.

inScope: Freezing the production or audit request with exact build truth
Creating master sources with attributable rights and provenance
Producing locale, channel, and accessibility variants
Running exact-file QA against current official requirements
outOfScope: Product claims, campaign strategy, and listing narrative
Upload, submission, certification, and live readback

inputs: Marketing brief or listing asset request with producer handoff
Brand, locale, accessibility, territory, rights, and disclosure rules
outputs: Finished files plus one independently acceptable production pack
Exact-file QA matrix and provenance record

tools: render and capture tooling for selected destinations
permissions: rights and disclosure authority per territory

failureSemantics: No upload, public claim, or rights exposure for dormant targets; external rights, talent, and platform approval are real authority gates never fabricated; every QA failure is a residual, and a change issues a new revision rather than a same-revision back-reference.

outcome.observable: A Product Asset Production Pack whose finished files match the approved brief and brand constraints, pass exact-file QA against current official requirements, carry rights and provenance, and include an honest residual list.
